not_stated-o.VDDQ i_max_ma: no guaranteed maximum for the read burst: IDD4RQ 94 mA is "reference only, typical" (Table 15 note 3, p52); recorded as i_typ_ma
not_stated-o.VDDQ i_step_ma: left out: the only active VDDQ figure is typical/reference-only
not_stated-o.ripple_max_mvpp: no separate allowance: Table 248 note 2 says the DC range is inclusive of all noise up to 20 MHz at the ball; note 3 says noise above 45 mV p-p (DC-20 MHz) is not included in TdIVW (a timing statement, not a supply limit)
not_stated-o.decap-ao: no decoupling recommendation found in the 327-page data sheet (searched "decoupl", "bypass")
not_stated-o.micron.com datasheet: micron.com part page offers no public PDF link (documents list loaded by script / customer portal); the Micron Rev. D 04/2023 PDF used here was fetched from datasheet.octopart.com
